page: Microsoft Azure DC2eds_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance within the DCEDv6 series, operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel processor and is provisioned with 2 dedicated vCPUs alongside 8.0 GB of system memory. This architecture maintains a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, delivering 4.0 GB of RAM per dedicated core for uniform execution predictability without shared-core resource contention.

Storage provisions for the DC2eds_v6 include 118 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD storage, suitable for high-speed scratch space, temporary indexing, and swap requirements. The virtual machine also supports Azure Premium Storage for persistent managed block volumes. The instance does not feature graphical processing hardware, nor does it include default complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring virtual network integration for inbound and outbound traffic routing.

By combining dedicated processing cores with high-speed local NVMe media, the instance offers balanced resource utilization for small-scale production systems. It is structured to handle small database deployments, web and application serving, lightweight caching tiers, continuous integration pipelines, and routine containerized workloads that require predictable processor access and low-latency local disk operations.
